"January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September",
lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
months := [(2024, 2), (2026, 8), (2026, 11)]
for: (year, month) := months[index]
    y := if month < 3 then year - 1 else year
    m := if month < 3 then month + 12 else month
    century := y / 100
    within := y % 100
    h := (1 + 13 * (m + 1) / 5 + within + within / 4 + century / 4 + 5 * century) % 7
    weekday := (h + 6) % 7
    days := lengths[month - 1]
    if month == 2 and (year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0))
        days = 29
    if index > 0
        println()
    println("{names[month - 1]} {year}{NL}Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa")
    fields := array(nat(weekday), fill = "  ")
    fields = fields.concat([for day := (1:days)[] then "{day:2.}"])
    weeks := fields.chunks(7)
    for week := weeks[]
        println(week.join(" "))
